caption.instagram:
New on AllFantasy: the game-day final call 📲

If one of your starters gets ruled out close to kickoff and he's still in your lineup, we send you one text:
✅ who's out
✅ the best swap on your bench, flex spots included
✅ a link to fix it

One text per player. Only when it matters. Turn it on in Settings → Notifications. Reply STOP anytime. Link in bio.
